title: Awkward controls and access
summary: Reviews in this topic describe awkward operation of cabin controls and displays, along with awkward physical access such as getting in and out or reaching storage areas.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention awkward vent, heating, brake, touchscreen, display, and menu operation, as well as awkward entry, exit, and access to door pockets.

limitations: This cluster mixes interface usability issues with physical access and reachability concerns rather than a single tightly focused problem.
The examples do not provide enough detail to determine whether one sub-issue is more important than the others.
